items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: And then my good friend Muggsy, he was causing me to leave in Sig.

ctx.x: That was the day when the swing was starting to come in.

Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. Ten men. They had, oh, Sig had some good men in his band. He had fellas like Bollie DeFoe, Muxi Spania, uh, uh, Bob Buscelli. I haven't heard much of him recently. He, wait, in the last 20 years or so, I think Bob had just wrapped up. He went in for the motion picture business. He didn't care too much about the, uh, music. Shorty Williamson, Georgie Petroni, Earl Andrews. Sig played fiddle. Sig played fiddle, yes. I was with the band, too. Did he double on anything else? No. A good part of the…

items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I worked with Arnold Lloyd Cannon with Sig Meyer. We had a band.

ctx.x: I worked with Arnold Lloyd Cannon with Sig Meyer. We had a band. Oh, yeah. You had a picture of that band. Yeah. It was one of the few swing bands in that area in Chicago. We had a good band, too. Volley Defoe was in that band, too.
How did Volley sound in the old days? Wonderful. I know he played a little bit with the Friars Inn group.
